name: portal-deploy
description: Safely expose, verify, and reach apps published through Portal tunnels.

interface.longDescription: Start or inspect a local app, publish it through Portal, verify the public HTTPS endpoint, and hand off a safe stop or persistence workflow. Or discover a service that someone else published through Portal, verify it is reachable, and handle x402 payment challenges with explicit approval.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this local app with Portal and verify the public URL.
Create a temporary Portal preview for this project.
Run this app as a persistent Portal tunnel.
Find this service on a Portal relay and check that it is reachable.
